description: Postes électriques (Transport) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération du Puy-en-Velay. This dataset presents, for Metropolitan France, all the electrical sites owned or co-owned by RTE or being the end of a RTE link. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération du Puy-en-Velay. The portal shows the English title as "Electric substations (Transport)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération du Puy-en-Velay. Its keywords include inspire, reseaux-de-transport, electricite. The listing shows 2 download or service links in OGC:WMS, OGC:WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
